title: Companion native configuration and saved conversation
description: Use the private simulator and prepared NATIVE_COMPANION_PROFILE_STATE; the outer runner always closes its fixture session.

profiles-scroll.intent: Bring the signed-out configuration into view through native scrolling.

verify-signed-out.intent: Verify actual signed-out state disables creation without launching a session.

model-scroll.intent: Bring the selected configuration and its refresh action into view.

create.intent: Start the selected configuration through Companion.

identity.intent: The newly created conversation displays its runner and session identity.

adopt.intent: Verify the actual session runner, model, directory and profile registration.

type-memory.value: Remember {{params.word}}. Reply with exactly that word. Use no tools.

verify-memory.intent: Verify one accepted/completed command and its real response.

draft.intent: Keep an unsent draft before closing.

close.intent: Close only the fixture session and verify stopped processes.

resume-ready.intent: The stopped conversation offers continuation through its saved runner session.

resume.intent: Resume the saved conversation from Companion.

verify-resumed.intent: Verify saved identity, new generation, retained draft and no replay.

recall.value: Reply with only the word you remembered earlier. Use no tools.
recall.intent: Replace the unsent draft with a memory question.

verify-recall.intent: Verify remembered context and exactly one additional command.

capture.intent: Record the preserved conversation and its response after resuming.

verify-authenticated.intent: The chosen native configuration is authenticated and permits a new conversation.

reconnect.intent: The chosen configuration survives a real mobile gateway disconnect and requires fresh login readiness.

replace-registration.intent: Replace only the private profile registration while preserving its native directory and credentials.

refresh-registration.intent: Refresh the selected configuration after its registration changed on the node.

verify-stale.intent: The old registration blocks creation and offers explicit selection of the updated profile.

accept-updated.intent: Explicitly accept the updated configuration registration.

verify-updated.intent: The explicitly accepted registration is ready to start the selected conversation.

profiles-ready.intent: The selected runner has loaded its available native configurations before choosing one.

setup-ready.intent: The connected gateway exposes available native runners in the creation form.

authenticated-visible.intent: Make the signed-in configuration reachable after the login warning appears.

refresh-visible.intent: Keep profile refresh reachable after reconnecting.

model-visible.intent: Reach the model choice after profile readiness changes.

create-visible.intent: Reach the start action for the selected configuration and model.

resume-visible.intent: Reach the saved conversation continuation action above its history.
